messages:
nina v: Publish pipeline on release/v1.15 failed: regen-check reports a removed CHANGELOG line that was added by the onboarding sample app commit. CI aborted the publish.

ci-bot: GH Actions · publish-typegen · FAILED
Job: regen-check -> non-empty diff detected
Logs: `CHANGELOG.md: removed line 'Example: auth retry pattern (sample-app)'`

owen g: I can reproduce. `yarn typegen` adds the line, but our changelog-sanitize step strips parentheticals and then a dedupe pass collapses what it thinks is a duplicate. That ends up removing the sample bullet.

harper d: the semver-detector sees no user-visible change and skips the minor bump. Bad interaction between sanitize+dedupe and semver logic.

nina v: short-term unblock: add a temporary suffix like ` [keep]` to the changelog bullet and re-run CI to unblock the release. We'll remove the suffix after a proper fix.

tooling-bot: created ticket TOOL-2042: "changelog-sanitize dedupe removes sample/example bullets causing semver false-negatives" (owner: owen g)

owen g: plan: (1) change sanitize to preserve bullets that start with `Example:` or contain `sample`/`sample-app`, (2) add unit tests and a fixture, (3) add a regendiff-replay CI job that runs typegen+sanitize in the same container to avoid mismatch between jobs.

harper d: also let's add a semver-detector flag `--treat-sanitize-delta-as-change` so we can be conservative while tooling teams iterate.

nina v: I'll push the temporary `[keep]` suffix to unblock and file a release note to remove it after the tools fix lands. Please coordinate on the PRs so we can land sanitize + semver change in the same window.

typegen-bot: typegen v2.6.0 · Generated files changed: CHANGELOG.md

ci-bot: re-run triggered by nina v: publish-typegen · queued

owen g: thanks — I'll open PR #1620 with the sanitize fix + regendiff-replay script (`tools/ci/regendiff-replay.sh`) and a test fixture. Marking as high priority.

harper d: one follow-up: update the sample-app generator templates to include a sentinel comment `<!-- keep-changelog-example -->` so authors don't have to add manual suffixes. Add a note in devex/onboarding.md.

nina v: CI re-run passed with suffix; leaving the release board note. Please ping release when PR #1620 merges so I can remove the temporary change. :thumbsup:
